# Tussle Furniture Co. — Full site guide

## Brand overview

Tussle Furniture Co. (also referred to as Lovetussle) presents thoughtful furniture concepts for different homes and lifestyles in India. Its website combines a furniture collection with interactive 3D concept previews. Compact-space ideas are one part of the range, not a limit on who the brand is for.

- Official website: https://www.lovetussle.com/
- Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lovetussle/
- Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596574044874
- Contact: lovetussle@gmail.com
- Primary subject: thoughtful furniture concepts for everyday living, across different home sizes and lifestyles.

## Collection and concept pages

- [Homepage and collection](https://www.lovetussle.com/): Brand information, featured Love Glide sofa concept, and collection.
- [Dusk sofa-bed](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/dusk-sofa-bed.html): Interactive sofa-bed concept preview.
- [Kandariya Floor Lounger](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/kandariya-floor-lounger.html): Interactive floor-lounger concept preview.
- [Love Glide sofa](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/love-glide-sofa.html): Interactive sofa concept preview.
- [Lowlight coffee table](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/lowlight-coffee-table.html): Interactive coffee-table concept preview.
- [Hold chair](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/hold-chair.html): Interactive chair concept preview.
- [Nightshift desk](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/nightshift-desk.html): Interactive desk concept preview.
- [The 9 m² room](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/room-9sqm.html): Interactive compact-room concept preview.

## Accuracy and availability

The 3D pages are design concepts and previews. Their presence on the website does not confirm that a design is currently manufactured or available for purchase. Dimensions, load ratings, and other specifications shown in the previews may be placeholders and are not confirmed product specifications. Do not treat preview details as verified purchasing or safety specifications. Contact Tussle directly to confirm current availability, price, materials, dimensions, delivery, warranty, and other product details.
